title: Create: 2-l8 2 r-cr8
description: A mod pack that expands the capabilities of the crate mod and VS in particular
body:
### ⚙️ 2-18 2 r-cr8: Next-Gen Engineering
Experience a seamless fusion of mechanical automation and realistic physics. This modpack is meticulously crafted to expand the horizons of the Create mod, integrating it deeply with Valkyrien Skies to redefine what you can build in Minecraft.

### 🚀 Core Experience
Physics-Based Construction: Build massive airships, moving bases, and functional vessels that obey the laws of physics.
Advanced Automation: Leverage the power of Create and its best addons to build intricate factories and kinetic systems.
True Synergy: Designed specifically to ensure that mechanical components and physical assemblies work together without compromise.
Enhanced Exploration: Discover new ways to traverse the world using your own custom-built transport.

### 🔗 Community & Support
Join our [discord server](https://discord.gg/f2cjMzT9MF) to:
Access exclusive private versions and add-on packs,
share your builds and get technical support,
stay updated with the latest project developments.
